On Dodge:
Drops a Parting Gift that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing <pve 440 /> <pvp [120] /> damage over 7.5 metres. Detonates instantly on contact with surface or enemy.

Parting Gift has an additional effect based on Subclass:
<arc/> Applies "Lite" Blind for <pve 7 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds
<solar/> 40<title +20 [ashes] /> Scorch
<stasis/> Slows for 2 seconds and refreshes existing Slow Stacks. Does not apply Slow Stacks.
<void/> "Lite" Suppress for <pve 9 /> <pvp [7] /> seconds [Does not apply to Guardians in Super]

"Lite" Blind does not count as an Arc Blind, and will not proc Arc Synergies.
"Lite" Suppression is not a regular Suppression. Explanation in <link Court's Void Sandbox Guide [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i1KUwgVkd8qhwYj481gkV9sZNJQCE-C3Q-dpQutPCi4/edit#gid=1079577444] />.
